title: Acme India Industries IPO Details
intro:
Acme India Industries IPO is a book build issue of ₹121.69 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 54.07 lakh shares aggregating to ₹105.98 crores and offer for sale of 8.02 lakh shares aggregating to ₹15.71 crores.

Acme India Industries IPO opens for subscription on Sep 30, 2026 and closes on Oct 6, 2026. The allotment for the Acme India Industries IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 7, 2026. Acme India Industries IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 9, 2026.

Acme India Industries IPO is set issue price band at ₹186 to ₹196 per share. The lot size for an application is 600 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,35,200 (1,200 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (1,800 shares), amounting to ₹3,52,800.

Hem Securities Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Acme India Industries IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Acme India is engaged in the Indian railway rolling stock sector, with a strong focus on designing, manufacturing, and maintaining railway coach interiors. The company works mainly through government tenders and provide turnkey solutions for furnishing new railway coaches, refurbishing old ones, and upgrading coach toilets. It also manufacture and supply various components to Indian Railways, ensuring our products meet their standards for comfort, safety, hygiene, and functionality.
The company operates two manufacturing units in Sonipat, Haryana, covering 116,000 sq. ft., with in-house lab and testing facilities.
Modern Coach Factory, Raebareli, North Eastern Railway, Gorakhpur, and Northern Western Railway, Jodhpur are some of the notable projects.
As on August 31, 2025, the company’s order book stood at Rs 40,208.20 lakhs.

Toilet Modernization: The company has successfully completed over 10,948 toilet upgrades in LHB and ICF coaches, focusing on hygiene and passenger comfort. faqs.question: How to apply in Acme India Industries IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Acme India Industries IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Acme India Industries IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Acme India Industries IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Acme India Industries IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: The Acme India Industries IPO opens on Wed, Sep 30, 2026 and closes on Tue, Oct 6, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Acme India Industries IPO?
faqs.answer: Acme India Industries IPO lot size is 600 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,35,200 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Acme India Industries IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Acme India Industries IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Acme India Industries IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Acme India Industries IPO will be done on Wednesday, October 7, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Thu, Oct 8, 2026 . Check the Acme India Industries IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Acme India Industries IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Acme India Industries IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Fri, Oct 9, 2026 .
